prompt_note: {{REPO}} is substituted by the runner with the absolute path of the nix-config checkout. Fixture bundles are excerpts; cross-links to concepts outside the excerpt are expected and not part of any eval. Every prompt declares the repo's own .okf/ out of bounds: it contains the post-trim versions of the fixtures (the answer key) — iteration 1 showed agents copying it instead of trimming.

evals.name: eval-density-trap
evals.prompt: The .okf bundle in this directory has gotten far too detailed. Trim it back to something usable. Treat {{REPO}} as read-only ground truth for checking facts, but only edit files inside this working directory. The repo's own .okf/ directory is out of bounds — check facts against the code, not against the repo's documentation.
evals.expected_output: lookup-hm-option.md collapses to a pointer at the home-manager-options SKILL.md; module-layout.md keeps every quantified constraint and barely shrinks.
assertions: module-layout.md still contains the 220 MiB figure
module-layout.md still contains the lib.mkAfter constraint
module-layout.md still names the monospace and emoji generics
module-layout.md still states that modules/global is loaded into both trees
lookup-hm-option.md no longer contains the four-row hm-options command table
lookup-hm-option.md no longer contains the 'stop and use hm-options first' instruction
lookup-hm-option.md points at .claude/skills/home-manager-options/SKILL.md
trimmed the restated file far harder than the dense one (shrink spread > 40 points)
module-layout.md shrank by less than 25 percent
both files still parse as OKF concepts with a non-empty type in frontmatter

evals.name: eval-log-rewrite
evals.prompt: Compact .okf/log.md in this directory. Every entry should be one short line naming what changed plus the concept that holds the detail, following CLAUDE.md rule 3 in {{REPO}}. Merge entries that describe one piece of work. The repo's own .okf/ directory is out of bounds — work from the rule, not from the repo's documentation.
evals.expected_output: 42 entries become 20-35, no SHAs, date headings preserved, and entry prose compressed to a ~100-char median measured with link markup excluded.
assertions: no 7-character hex SHA remains anywhere in log.md
all 14 YYYY-MM-DD headings are present and in the original order
the five 2026-08-16 entries were merged into 1 or 2
median entry prose (excluding link markup) is at or under 100 characters
at most a quarter of entries exceed the 100-character prose budget
entry count is between 20 and 35 inclusive
every entry that originally had a concept link still has at least one link
no concept link target was invented — all links match paths that existed in the original log

evals.name: eval-leak-vs-constraint
evals.prompt: Behavioral rules have leaked into the .okf bundle in this directory, and there is duplicated content between concepts. Clean it up. Use {{REPO}} as read-only ground truth; the repo's own .okf/ directory is out of bounds — check facts against the code, not against the repo's documentation. No user is available for questions: when the skill calls for a consult, write the full batched consult to consult.md in this directory instead, and treat every unanswered item as kept.
evals.expected_output: Duplication resolved to one authority; rebuild.md commands untouched; the krank imperative surfaced in consult.md with its reason kept; human-verified files not silently rewritten.
assertions: rebuild.md still contains 'nh os switch'
rebuild.md still contains the standalone home-manager switch command
rebuild.md still contains 'nix run .#test-lib'
track-upstream-blockers.md still contains the /issues/ link-form constraint
track-upstream-blockers.md still contains krank:ignore-line
the reason a merged PR can still be the cause of a bug survives somewhere
the consult proposes collapsing the duplicated 'second machine' litmus test to a single authority file, asking whether to trim the human-verified pair anyway
with the consult unanswered, the duplicated test survives in both profile files — no unilateral collapse of human-verified text
neither profile file retains an unchanged human:joker9944 verified block over rewritten text
consult.md exists and is a single batched consult, not one file or section per item
consult.md lists the Playbook prose imperatives, and those imperatives survive unchanged in the concept files
